caption:
Tonight's self-reflection: what did you send ahead?

Allah calls the believers to be mindful of Him and to let every soul consider what it has sent forth for tomorrow. He is All-Aware of what we do. Look back at today, then make tomorrow count.

Surah Al-Hashr 59:18

Name one deed from today you want to send ahead

#selfreflection #muhasabah #taqwa #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
